purpose: Normalize governed music works, song versions, semantic annotations, private original text, media and public projections in Neon without changing Frozen Rune Canon.

zones.bronze: Imported source snapshots and lineage only.
zones.silver: Normalized works, song versions, semantic annotations, media and Visibility/Projection governance.
zones.vault: Private original text including lyrics, author source text, retrieval text and drafts.
zones.gold: Public projections only; Gold never reads private vault text.

visibility_contract.rule: source_publication_status records observed source state; application public access is decided by silver.resource_visibility.

privacy_invariant: gold.public_works and gold.public_song_versions never join vault. Full projection means the full safe projected record, never raw private lyrics or author text.
migration_order: Import the complete song-version corpus and work identities into Silver; write lyrics only to Vault.
Merge governed public-work annotations into Silver.
Populate resource visibility from governance rules.
Validate counts, uniqueness, missing lyrics, mixed-publication work groups and search exclusions.
Point public reads at Gold only after validation.
Rebuild embeddings after the normalized private corpus is stable.
